ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels covering approximately 80% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white/grey) pixel clusters localized at the distal lobe tips and along the right lobe margin.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity region at the center and base. High-contrast white mottling and 'marbling' patterns are spatially mapped to the outer 15% of the right lobe and the extreme distal tip of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped median notch with a pixel-measured interior angle of approximately 55 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of 1:4 relative to the central base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern along the entire visible trailing edge; right lobe displays higher amplitude pixel-variation (peaks) compared to the left lobe which has more subdued, lower-frequency ripples.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-concave trajectory originating from the median notch, transitioning into a linear upward sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentration of circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (5-10 pixels in diameter) localized on the right lobe distal region; scattered individual white focal spots present on the central dark surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, parallel diagonal linear streaks visible on the left lobe's central-medial region, cutting across the primary black pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe structural irregularity and potential tissue loss at the distal tips of both lobes, characterized by atypical reddish-brown pixel values and ragged edge topography.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant reddish-brown coloration at the extreme distal apices of both lobes, providing a distinct chromatic contrast to the standard black/white fluke pigmentation.
